newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN CENTRAL BANK SAYS INJECTING FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN CENTRAL BANK SAYS INJECTING FUNDS.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank, responding to rising money rates on tight liquidity, said it would inject funds into the banking system on Thursday.
A central bank official said the bank would execute open market operations on Thursday through repurchase of negotiable certificates of deposit offered by interested financial institutions.
The institutions have the option of repurchasing the NCDs within five days, the official said.
The central bank said interested financial institutions should contact the bank directly.
Bids would close at 10.30 a.m. (0230 GMT).
Funds would be released according to actual demand, the central bank said.
